# Calculate overall mesozooplankton abundance and copepod fraction by depth
- In darkedge 2021, three samples have very high image number in the 5m bins around 105 m for copepoda, these are: "de430_004_yo01" "de430_004_yo02" "de430_004_yo03". Could this be an artifact of repeated images or actually a concentration max? The sampled volumes at these bins were actually very high so the number of images are likely true.
```{r}
abund <- uvp6_de %>% 
  # bind_rows(uvp6_am) %>% 
  rename(lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat, 
         date = object_date, depth = object_depth_min,
         volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, Depth_5m, volume_m3, taxagroup) %>% 
  summarise(nimgs = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance = nimgs/volume_m3)


# To get abundance at other bin sizes, need to full join ?the volume data in uvp6_ecopart so it records the bins with zero abundance. Easier if the ecopart data is pre binned
binsize <-  50
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_ecopart %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            nbins = n()) %>% 
  mutate(binsize = binsize)

# integrated to 50 m depth bins [must sum individuals and divide by volume BUT including zero abundances], not just average

abundBin <- abund %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Depth_5m, volume_m3, abundance)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin %>% select(-nbins),
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, depthBin, taxagroup, binsize, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(nimgsBin = sum(nimgs),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundanceBin = nimgsBin / volume_m3)
  
# Total abundance and copepod fraction
abundBinTotal <- abundBin %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  summarise(abundanceTotal = sum(abundanceBin), 
            nimgsTotal = sum(nimgsBin),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  # Copepod fraction of abundance
  left_join(abundBin %>% 
              filter(taxagroup == "Copepoda") %>% 
              select(sample_id, depthBin, abundCope = abundanceBin),
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  mutate(copepod_frac = abundCope/abundanceTotal) %>% 
  mutate(copepod_frac = if_else(is.na(copepod_frac),
                                0, copepod_frac))


ggplot(abundBinTotal, aes(y = abundanceTotal, x = depthBin,
                          fill = copepod_frac)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = sample_id), alpha = 0.4)+
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  guides(color="none")

# TODO add fraction of copepods with lipid segmented
```

# Surface concentrations
Stereographic (North Pole): EPSG 3995
Azimuthal Equal-area (North Pole): EPSG 3413
```{r}
binsize <-  150
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_ecopart %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            nbins = n()) %>% 
  mutate(binsize = binsize)

# integrated to 50 m depth bins [must sum individuals and divide by volume BUT including zero abundances], not just average

abundBin <- abund %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Depth_5m, volume_m3, abundance)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin %>% select(-nbins),
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, depthBin, taxagroup, binsize, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(nimgsBin = sum(nimgs),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundanceBin = nimgsBin / volume_m3)
  
# Total abundance and copepod fraction
abundBinTotal <- abundBin %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  summarise(abundanceTotal = sum(abundanceBin), 
            nimgsTotal = sum(nimgsBin),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  # Copepod fraction of abundance
  left_join(abundBin %>% 
              filter(taxagroup == "Copepoda") %>% 
              select(sample_id, depthBin, abundCope = abundanceBin),
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  mutate(copepod_frac = abundCope/abundanceTotal) %>% 
  mutate(copepod_frac = if_else(is.na(copepod_frac),
                                0, copepod_frac))

ggplot(abundBinTotal, aes(y = abundanceTotal, x = depthBin,
                          fill = copepod_frac)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = sample_id), alpha = 0.4)+
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  guides(color="none")


library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)

abund_filtered <- abundBinTotal %>% 
  filter(depthBin == 0)

# *********** AKIMA-style basic interpolation *****************
library(akima)
# Interpolate values over a grid
interp_data <- with(abund_filtered, 
                    akima::interp(x = lon, y = lat, z = abundanceTotal,
                                  duplicate = "mean", extrap = FALSE))
# Convert interpolated data to data frame for ggplot
interp_df <- with(interp_data, 
                  expand.grid(x = x, y = y) |> 
                    transform(z = as.vector(z)))

# Get world coastlines as an sf object
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  # geom_density_2d_filled(data = abund_filtered,
  #                       aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = abundanceTotal), 
  #                        contour_var = "ndensity", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_raster(data = interp_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = z), interpolate = TRUE, alpha = 0.7) +
  # geom_contour(data = interp_df, aes(x = x, y = y, z = z), color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 0.4) +
  
  geom_point(data = abund_filtered,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = abundanceTotal),
       size = 5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Interpolated", trans = "log10") +
  coord_sf(xlim = range(abund_filtered$lon),
           ylim = range(abund_filtered$lat),
           expand = FALSE) +
  guides(fill="none")


# *********** Kriging interpolation *****************
# TODO krigging errors!
library(gstat)
# Convert to sf object
abund_sf <- st_as_sf(abund_filtered, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Transform to projected CRS for distance-based analysis
abund_proj <- st_transform(abund_sf, crs = 3857)  # Web Mercator

# Create a grid for interpolation
grid_proj <- st_make_grid(abund_proj, cellsize = 10000, what = "centers") |> 
  st_as_sf() 

# Convert to Spatial* objects (needed for gstat)
abund_sp <- as_Spatial(abund_proj)
grid_sp <- as_Spatial(grid_proj)

# Fit variogram model
vgm_model <- variogram(abundanceTotal ~ 1, data = abund_sp)
fit_vgm <- fit.variogram(vgm_model, model = vgm("Sph"))

# Kriging interpolation
kriging_result <- krige(formula = abundanceTotal ~ 1, locations = abund_sp, 
                        newdata = grid_sp, model = fit_vgm)

# Convert kriging result to sf and back to original CRS
kriging_sf <- st_as_sf(kriging_result) |> st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Plotting
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kriging_sf, aes(fill = var1.pred), color = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_contour(data = kriging_sf |> 
                 st_coordinates() |> 
                 as.data.frame() |> 
                 bind_cols(pred = kriging_sf$var1.pred),
               aes(x = X, y = Y, z = pred), color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = abund_filtered,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = abundanceTotal),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Interpolated", trans = "log10") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Observed", trans = "log10") +
  coord_sf(xlim = range(abund_filtered$lon), 
           ylim = range(abund_filtered$lat),
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```




# Check the taxonomy list and export the reduced data 
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# The sumarised abundance by sample
uvp6_de_sum <- read.table("../../UVP/ecotaxa_exported_tsv/export_summary_5108_20250320_2118.tsv",
                          sep = '\t', header = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(count != 0)
uvp6_am_sum <- read.table("../../UVP/ecotaxa_exported_tsv/export_summary_10101_20250320_2126.tsv",
                          sep = '\t', header = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(count != 0)

uvp6_de <- read.table("../../UVP/ecotaxa_exported_tsv/ecotaxa_export_5108_20250320_2120.tsv",
                          sep = '\t', header = TRUE) 

uvp6_am <- read.table("../../UVP/ecotaxa_exported_tsv/ecotaxa_export_10101_20250320_2129.tsv",
                          sep = '\t', header = TRUE) 

taxanames <- unique(c(uvp6_am_sum$taxonid, uvp6_de_sum$taxonid))
taxanames

# Identify list of names to exclude (detritus, Rhizaria)
pattern <- paste(c("detritus","feces","egg","t00","dead","antenna","tentacle","part","over segmented","Actinopterygii",
                   "artefact","sphere","crystal","turbid","reflection",
                   "bubble","badfocus",
                   "othertocheck","dark","Collodaria",
                   "solitary","Medusettidae","rhizaria","Rhizaria",
                   "Aulacanthidae","Aulophaeridae","Cannosphaeridae",
                   "Aulosphaeridae","Coelodendridae","Coelographis"),
                 collapse = "|")
to_exclude_taxa <- taxanames[grepl(pattern, taxanames)]

to_exclude_taxa
sort(taxanames[!grepl(pattern, taxanames)])


# Curate taxa list
nrow(uvp6_de)
uvp6_de <- uvp6_de %>% 
  filter(object_annotation_category %notin% to_exclude_taxa)

nrow(uvp6_am)
uvp6_am <- uvp6_am %>% 
  filter(object_annotation_category %notin% to_exclude_taxa)

# Organize to major groups
taxamatch <- tibble(object_annotation_category = 
                          unique(c(uvp6_am$object_annotation_category,
                                   uvp6_de$object_annotation_category))) %>% 
  arrange(object_annotation_category) %>% 
  mutate(taxaname = object_annotation_category) %>% 
  mutate(taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Copepoda<Maxillopoda"),
                        "Copepoda", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("side<with visible lipid sac",
                                            "top-bottom<with visible lipid sac"),
                            "Calanus", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Cnidaria<Metazoa"),
                            "Cnidaria", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Ctenophora X", "Ctenophora<Metazoa"),
                            "Ctenophora", taxaname),
         taxaname = if_else(taxaname %in% c("larvae<Echinodermata"),
                            "Echinodermata", taxaname)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = taxaname) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Calanus","Metridia","Paraeuchaeta",
                                             "Oncaeidae"),
                             "Copepoda", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Hyperiidea"),
                             "Amphipoda", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Beroe abyssicola","Cydippida"),
                             "Ctenophora", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Limacinidae","Clionidae"),
                             "Pteropoda", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Eukrohnia"),
                             "Chaetognatha", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Phyllodocida","Swima","Poeobius"),
                             "Annelida", taxagroup),
         taxagroup = if_else(taxaname %in% c("Euphysa","Halitholus",
                                             "Aeginopsis","Aglantha digitale",
                                             "Botrynema ellinorae"),
                             "Hydromedusae", taxagroup))

uvp6_am <- uvp6_am %>% 
  left_join(taxamatch)


uvp6_de <- uvp6_de %>% 
  left_join(taxamatch)

# Add the volume per 5m bin information from ECOPART
uvp6_de_ecopart <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_52_darkedge2021/export_reduced_20250311_volumes.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  # Rename sample_id and Depth_5m to clearly specify bin size
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  # convert volume in L to m3
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)
uvp6_amund_ecopart <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_40_Amudsen2023/export_reduced_20250311_volumes.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  # convert volume in L to m3
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)

uvp6_ecopart <- bind_rows(uvp6_de_ecopart, uvp6_amund_ecopart)

# Match sample to volume (+- 2.5)
uvp6_am <- uvp6_am %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_min / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_de_ecopart,
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m))

uvp6_de <- uvp6_de %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_min / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_de_ecopart,
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) 


save(uvp6_am, uvp6_de, taxamatch, uvp6_ecopart,
     file = "data/uvp6_deam_living_20250320.RData")
```

## Check if the ecopart 5m bin skips and if volumes are consistent
```{r}
ggplot(uvp6_de_ecopart, aes(x = Depth_5m, y = Sampled_volume_L, 
                            color = sample_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()

AA <- uvp6_de_ecopart %>% 
  filter(Sampled_volume_L > 1000)

# Check for gaps in Depth_5m per sample_id
depth_gaps <- uvp6_de_ecopart %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    actual_depths = list(sort(unique(Depth_5m))),
    expected_depths = list(seq(min(Depth_5m, na.rm = TRUE),
                               max(Depth_5m, na.rm = TRUE),
                               by = 5)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_depths = map2(expected_depths, actual_depths, setdiff),
    has_gaps = lengths(missing_depths) > 0
  )

# No gaps so can full join!
```
